title: Stabilize shared Codex stdin watchdog timeout test
outcome: Full serial backend validation for the Engram adapter intermittently failed tests::session_stop::shared_codex_stdin_watchdog_times_out_stalled_writer_and_clears_runtime while isolated reruns passed. This is a pre-existing timing/flakiness issue outside the Engram adapter scope and must not be normalized as an acceptable flaky gate.
acceptance: The watchdog test uses deterministic coordination or a proven bounded deadline, passes repeatedly under the full serial suite, and still asserts the stalled writer is timed out and runtime state is cleared.
